description: September 21 birthday meaning: Virgo or Libra cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, September 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Virgo or Libra. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: September 21 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 21st of September sits on the Virgo–Libra cusp, so the Sun sign depends on the birth year and exact time; in most years it is still in the late twenties of Virgo. Either way, discernment meets diplomacy here. The birthday number 3 adds expressiveness, giving a charming critic's voice, someone who can deliver honest feedback and leave people feeling flattered.

On September 21 the Sun usually sits at about 28° Virgo, in the third decan, where Venus is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. Born around September 21 to September 23, close to the equinox, you sit between Virgo and Libra. Earth hands over to air, and practicality to partnership. The precise day and minute of the Sun's move into Libra changes with the year, so your actual sign depends on birth year, time and location, which a natal chart can resolve. Those who feel both influences are often described as refined and thoughtful: careful about details, invested in fairness and drawn to beauty that also works. Decisions may take time, because both signs like to get things right.

sections.heading: September 21 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 21 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on September 21: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 21 is the 264th day of the year (265th in a leap year). By September 23, 2 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Libra.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 21, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 21 include H. G. Wells (1866), Shinzō Abe (1954) and Kwame Nkrumah (1909).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 21?
faq.answer: September 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Virgo or Libra on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Virgo. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 21 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 21?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 21 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 21?
faq.answer: September 21 is also the birthday of H. G. Wells (1866), Shinzō Abe (1954) and Kwame Nkrumah (1909). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
